system.description:
Once per encounter, you may ready to fire a single weapon at the same target as an ally, and you coordinate with a single weapon of your ally.

If both attacks hit, you add the damage of the two weapons together before applying the target's Shield Rating or Damage Reduction, and treat it as a single attack for purposes of exceeding the target's Damage Threshold.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Starships of the Galaxy
